brief:
Military police have accused an Israeli soldier of beating a Palestinian detainee, urinating on him, and smearing faeces on his face, Middle East Eye reported. The allegations emerged through an investigation by military police into the soldier's conduct.

Details of the incident and the detainee's identity were not immediately disclosed. The case marks another documented allegation of abuse against a Palestinian in Israeli custody.

title: Israeli soldier accused of abusing Palestinian detainee
